name: Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018
description: Establishes obligations for owners/operators of critical infrastructure assets across 11 sectors — asset registration, mandatory cyber incident reporting, and enhanced government assistance powers.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Department of Home Affairs (homeaffairs.gov.au) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Department of Home Affairs (homeaffairs.gov.au).
